note: «Бо́жья во́ля» is 'God's will' and «бо́жьи созда́ния» 'God's creatures' — the relational possessive sense, which the graded gloss 'divine' does not accept, and the corpus already glosses relational adjectives this way (детский "children's", солдатский "soldier's").

«Э́та ка́рта верне́е, чем ста́рая» needs 'more accurate', a correctness sense absent from 'faithful (loyal and trustworthy)'; the note separates it from то́чный "exact (precise and accurate)" and пра́вильный "correct (free from error)".
The person sense «Он о́чень вре́дный челове́к» is already carried by the existing alt 'nasty' and named in the standard note, so nothing is absent.
«го́лые дере́вья» and «го́лый пол» need 'bare', which is already an accepted alt.
All three sentences need only 'ready' or 'willing', both already accepted; the flag on «Обе́д уже́ гото́в» is about обе́д, not this gloss.
«Нас встре́тили гро́зные взгля́ды» renders as 'menacing looks' — 'formidable looks' is not English — and no accepted answer covers the threatening sense.
«У него́ бога́тый жи́зненный о́пыт» is 'life experience', the plain attributive 'of life' sense the gloss 'vital' does not accept; formatted like the corpus's existing ночно́й "night (as modifier)".
«У бе́рега вода́ ме́льче» needs 'shallower' and «Э́то ме́лкий песо́к» needs 'fine sand'; both senses are mentioned only inside the standard note, so neither is an accepted answer.
The 'lovely' of «Кака́я ми́лая соба́ка!» and «У них ми́лые де́ти» is the same sense as the existing alts 'sweet' and 'cute', so no sense is missing — only a synonym would be added.
«Я слы́шала ночно́й шум» ('a night-time noise') is covered by the existing alt 'night (as modifier)'.
«У нас о́бщая цель» is 'a common goal' and «Они́ живу́т в о́бщем до́ме' a shared house; 'general' is the only accepted answer and does not reach that shared-by-all sense.
«Он о́чень обяза́тельный челове́к» needs 'reliable', which is already an accepted alt.
«Мне нра́вится о́страя еда́» needs 'spicy', already an accepted alt.
The 'healthy' of «Фру́кты поле́знее конфе́т» is the same good-for-you sense as the existing alt 'beneficial'; accepting 'healthy' outright would blur поле́зный against здоро́вый.
«У него́ ры́жий кот» needs 'ginger', already an accepted alt.
All three sentences use 'northern'; the flag on «се́верные города́» concerns го́род, not this gloss.
«Мы встре́тили случа́йных люде́й» needs 'random' and «случа́йный гость» 'chance' — both are already accepted alts.

alt: consonant (a speech sound that is not a vowel)
note: «В сло́ве есть согла́сная бу́ква» needs the phonetic sense, which appears only inside the standard note and is not an accepted answer.
«Учи́тель рабо́тает в сре́дней шко́ле» can only be 'a secondary school', and neither 'average', 'middle' nor 'medium' is accepted English for сре́дняя шко́ла.

Two of three sentences need it — «земля́ ста́ла сыро́й» and «в сыро́м подва́ле» — and 'damp' sits only inside the standard note; the parenthetical marks the ground/room use that separates it from вла́жный "damp (slightly wet)".
All three sentences use 'royal', and the tsar reading is already stated in the standard note.
All three sentences need plain 'again', which is already an accepted alt.
«Вро́де всё гото́во» needs the 'seemingly' reading, which the existing alt 'it seems' already accepts.
'Perfectly' in «Я прекра́сно тебя́ понима́ю» is an intensifier collocation rather than a separate sense, and accepting it would loosen прекра́сно against отли́чно/соверше́нно.
All three sentences are covered by 'anniversary' with 'jubilee' already an alt; the flags ask for retranslation, not a wider gloss.
«Ребёнок сиде́л у неё на бедре́» needs 'hip', which is already an accepted alt.

alt: egg white (the clear part of an egg)
note: «Отдели́ бело́к от желтка́» is squarely the egg sense, which is mentioned only inside the standard note and is not an accepted answer.
«Она́ су́шит бельё на балко́не» is drying the laundry, not underwear, and 'linen' does not reach the washing sense.
«Прости́те за беспоко́йство» needs 'trouble' in the disturbance sense, absent from 'anxiety'/'worry'; the note separates it from неприя́тность "trouble (an unpleasant situation)".
«Э́ти величи́ны равны́» needs 'quantities', already an accepted alt.
All three sentences render the word as 'version', so no sentence here actually needs the police-lead sense, and accepting 'theory' would loosen ве́рсия against тео́рия.
All three sentences use 'top'; the flag on «С ве́рха горы́» concerns го́род, not this gloss.

alt: appearance (how a person or thing looks)
note: Three sentences each need a sense 'view' does not accept — «У него́ уста́лый вид» (appearance), «Я интересу́юсь э́тим ви́дом спо́рта» (kind), «ре́дкие ви́ды птиц» (species); the first note separates it from появле́ние "appearance (the act of coming into view)".
«Он внёс большо́й вклад в нау́ку» needs 'contribution', already an accepted alt.
Every sentence renders вну́к(и) as 'grandson(s)'; the flag asks for the sentence to be retranslated, not for a wider gloss.
«Я воспо́льзовалась удо́бной возмо́жностью» needs 'opportunity', already an accepted alt.
The pre-exam nerves of «Волне́ние пе́ред экза́меном» fall under the existing alt 'agitation (state of worry or upset)'.
«Он рассказа́л мне о своём де́ле» is rendered 'his case', a sense 'matter' does not accept; the note separates it from слу́чай "case (an occasion or instance)".
«Меха́ник заказа́л но́вую дета́ль для маши́ны» needs the machine-component sense; the note separates it from часть "part (a portion or section of a whole)".
«Защища́ть Ро́дину — его́ долг» needs 'duty', already an accepted alt.
